translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content: Yinni Gusunɔ u Yeremi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ ǹ nɛn tɔmbu Yudɑbɑ wɔnwɔndu kuɑmmɛ, bɑɑ Mɔwisi kɑ Sɑmuɛli bɑ̀ n nɑ nɛn mi, bu kɑ mɑn suuru kɑnɑ ben sɔ̃. Kon bu sɔ̃wɑ n nɛɛ, bu doonɔ nɛn wuswɑɑn di.
Bɑ̀ n mɑɑ wunɛ Yeremi bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mɑnɑ bɑ koo dɑ, kpɑ ɑ bu wisi ɑ nɛɛ,

content.text: bɑ koo gbiwɑ.
Gɑbɑ koo ben yɑron gɔɔ gbi, gɔɔ wiyɑ koo bu suɑ.
Gɑbɑ koo gbi tɑbu sɔɔ, gɔɔ wiyɑ koo bu suɑ.
Gɑbɑ koo gbi gɔ̃ɔrun sɔ̃, gɔɔ wiyɑ koo bu suɑ.
Kpɑ bu mɑɑ gɑbu yoru mwɛɛri, yoo terɑ bɑ koo di.

content: Kon de kɛ̃sinu nnɛ yu bu deemɑ. Bɑ koo gbi tɑbu sɔɔ, kpɑ bɔ̃nu nu ben gonu gɛɛri, kpɑ gbeeku yɛɛ kɑ gunɔsu bu di mɑm mɑm.
Biti kɑ bɛrum koo bwese tukunu mwɑ bɑ̀ n wɑ ye yɑ bu deemɑ, ye Yudɑn sinɑ boko Mɑnɑse Esekiɑsin bii u kuɑn sɔ̃ kpuro Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.

content.text: Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Yerusɑlɛmu,
wɑrɑ u koo wunɛn wɔnwɔndu wɑ.
Wɑrɑ u koo nun wɑnyo kuɑ.
Wɑrɑ u koo nɑ u bikiɑ ye n nun mɔ̀.
Wee ɑ mɑn deri, mɑ ɑ biru wurɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, kon nun nɔmɑ doke n nun kpeerɑsiɑ.
Domi nɑ wɑsirɑ kɑ bɑɑdommɑn wɔnwɔn te nɑ nun kuɑmmɛ.
Kon nɛn tɔn be sɑrɑwɑ nge dobi
wusun gbɑ̃rɑ kɔnnɔsɔ.
Kon de bu ben bibu biɑ, kpɑ n bu kɑm koosiɑ.
Domi bɑ yinɑ bu ben swɛɛ kɔ̃si deri.
Kon de ben gɔminibu bu yɑni sɛɛri dɑbiru kerɑ
yi yi wɑ̃ɑ nim wɔ̃kun goorɔ.
Kon de yibɛrɛbɑ bu nɑ
bu ben ɑluwɑɑsibɑn mɛrobu wɔri sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ gbɑ̃ɑrɑ.
Kpɑ nuku sɑnkirɑru kɑ bɛrum ben mɛro be deemɑ subɑru sɔɔ.
Wi bɑ rɑɑ bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ɛmɔ
yèn sɔ̃ u bii tɔn durɔbu nɔɔbɑ yiru mɑrɑ
u wɑsikirɑmɔ.
U koo mɑm gbiwɑ sɛkum kɑ seku bɑkɑru.
Be bɑ tie, kon de yibɛrɛbɑ bu bu gowɑ tɑbu sɔɔ.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni geruɑ.
nɛn mɛro, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ mɑn mɑrɑ.
Wee nɑ kuɑ bɔ̃ruro.
Domi nɛn sɔ̃nɑ tem mɛn tɔmbu kpuro
bɑ sikirinɑmɔ bɑ sɑnnɑmɔ.
Nɑ ǹ goon mi gɑ̃ɑnu bɔkure,
nɑ ǹ mɑɑ goo gɑ̃ɑnu bɔkure.
Adɑmɑ kɑ mɛ, bɑ mɑn bɔ̃rusimɔwɑ kpuro.
kon nun yɑkiɑ wunɛn geɑn sɔ̃,
kpɑ n nun wunɛn yibɛrɛbɑ kɑmiɑ
wɑhɑlɑ kɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnun sɑɑ.
Goo kun kpɛ̃ u sisu bɔɔku,
si su wee sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm geu giɑn di
kɑ sere mɑɑ sii gɑndu.
Kon de yibɛrɛbɑ bu nɑ
bu tem mɛn ɑrumɑni kpuro gurɑ
nɛn tɔmbun durum sɔ̃ ye bɑ kuɑ tem mɛ kpuro sɔɔ.
Kon de bu ben yibɛrɛbɑ sɑ̃ tem tukumɔ mi bɑ ǹ yɛ̃.
Domi nɛn mɔru seewɑwɑ be sɔɔ nge dɔ̃ɔ.

content: Yerɑ Yeremi u Yinni Gusunɔ wisɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: ɑ kpuro yɛ̃.
A mɑn yɑɑyo. A ku mɑn duɑri.
A be bɑ mɑn nɔni sɔ̃ɔmɔ mɔru kɔsio.
A ku mɑn go, wunɛ wi ɑ suuru mɔ.
A yɛ̃ mɑ wunɛn sɔ̃nɑ nɑ sekuru sɔɔwɑ.
Wunɛn gɑri kpurowɑ nɑ swɑɑ dɑki.
Mɑ nɑ yi doke gɔ̃ruɔ.
Yiyɑ yi mɑn nuku dobu wɛ̃.
Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni,
ɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ wunɛn yĩsirɑ nɑ sɔɔwɑ.
Mɛyɑ nɑ ǹ wure n sinɑ kɑ tɔn yɑɑ kɑsikiobu
su kɑ nuku dobu ko sɑnnu.
Nɑ tii gɔwɑwɑ nɑ sɔ̃ nɛ turo,
domi ɑ derɑ nɛn mɔru seewɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ,
mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ nɑ wɑhɑlɑ mɔ̀ sere kɑ tɛ̃.
Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ yɑ sɑ̃ɑ nge boo wi u ku rɑ kpe.
Yinni, kɑɑ n mɑn sɑ̃ɑwɛwɑ nge bwiɑ ye yɑ ǹ nɑɑnɛ mɔ,
ǹ kun mɛ nge dɑɑ te tɑ rɑ nim kpe?

content: Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Yeremi wisɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: ɑ̀ n gɔsirɑmɑ nɛn mi,
kon de ɑ mɑɑ ko nɛn sɔm kowo.
À n wurɑ ɑ mɛm sɑɑrinu deri
kpɑ ɑ gɑri ɑrufɑɑnigii gere,
kon mɑɑ nɛn gɑri doke wunɛn nɔɔwɔ.
N ǹ mɔ wunɑ kɑɑ gɔsirɑ ben mi,
beyɑ n weenɛ bu wurɑmɑ wunɛn mi.
Kon de ɑ n dɑm mɔ
nge gbɑ̃rɑ te bɑ kuɑ kɑ sii gɑndu.
Bɑ koo kɑ nun tɑbu ko,
ɑdɑmɑ bɑ ǹ nun kɑmiɑmɔ.
Domi ko nɑ n kɑ nun wɑ̃ɑ n nun fɑɑbɑ ko.
Kon nun yɑkiɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobun nɔmɑn di.
Kpɑ n nun wɔrɑ be bɑ nuki sosun nɔmɑn di.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni geruɑ.
